own_solution.law: v_max = sqrt(mu g r) from mu m g = m v^2 / r on a flat curve
assumptions: car's path radius is the stated 50 m (inner edge) unless a sentence moves it

defect_reasons.other: The base says the 50 m radius is the inner edge of the road but does not say in so many words that the car follows the inner edge; the natural reading (car's path radius 50 m) is the one certified.

notes: Checked answers: r=50: sqrt(294)=17.146; r=54: sqrt(317.52)=17.819; r=57.5: sqrt(338.1)=18.388; r=61.5: sqrt(361.62)=19.016. All match. Mass cancels for all values. Minimal pairs T02CA/T82EB (cyclist vs car, same 7.5 m) and T9AEC/TF5BA (earlier run vs this run, same 7.5 m) differ only in attachment. Disagreement with pass 1: I flagged rendering_not_minimal for T7092 and T5A6E; the claims show these are declared numeral-free controls twinned with T9AEC and T02CA, differing only by replacing '7.5 m' with 'a little', so I withdraw that flag. The cyclist's lane is on a path beside the road, so no physical coupling to the car.
